name: dp-gnosis
description: Retrieval over a curated markdown atom vault. Liftable unit: code here, vault at gnosis/, runtime at .dp-gnosis/.
comment:dependencies: better-sqlite3 backs the FTS5 adapter; it already resolves from the repo root, so nothing new is installed — declared here so this package stays a liftable unit (decision N-1). `stemmer` is NOT optional: it is applied uniformly via processTerm to every adapter, so a missing one would silently change ranking rather than skip a leg. MIT, zero transitive deps (§IX round approved 2026-08-08).
comment:optionalDependencies: Adapter-gated packages, approved in the COMMON.md §IX round of 2026-08-08 (plan T-18 / T-20). Loaded by LAZY DYNAMIC IMPORT so an absent one skips its adapter instead of breaking the suite. The loader MUST catch ALL import errors, not just MODULE_NOT_FOUND: @lancedb/lancedb can fail at import time with a native BINDING error on a platform whose prebuilt binary lags the root version, and a narrow catch would hard-fail the suite instead of skipping the adapter. apache-arrow is @lancedb/lancedb's required peer.
